title: Neurotypical woman with a head injury reaches the space non-speakers touch
summary: Ky Dickens tells of Neurotypical woman with a head injury reaches the space non-speakers touch, about 2020s at unspecified, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: 92 there's a a neurotypical woman who has a head injury that is able to touch the space that non-speakers can touch

plain: A documentary filmmaker named Ky Dickens says that her series The Telepathy Tapes, about non-speaking people said to share thoughts, includes a neurotypical woman, meaning someone whose brain works in the usual way, who after a head injury can reach the same mental space that non-speakers reach. If true, it would suggest that this shared space is open to anyone under the right conditions.
